default_lifecycle_paragraph: **Default lifecycle (all supported hosts):** `/discussx` → `/planx` → `/implementx` → `/verifyx`. Pre-execution (`discussx`, `planx`) is doc-only; `implementx` runs **all waves in one breath** per `WAVE_STATE.json`; `verifyx` merges verify + ship. Profile `my-light` disables REVIEW_GATE hard block. Legacy `/gsd-*` removed (2026-05); use My commands only.

lifecycle_by_host.cursor: **Default lifecycle: My** — `/discussx` → `/planx` → `/implementx` → `/verifyx`. Pre-execution (`discussx`, `planx`) is doc-only; `implementx` runs **all waves in one breath** per `WAVE_STATE.json`; `verifyx` merges verify + ship. Goal/RFV: `framework_goal_drive` / `framework_rfv_loop` stdio + `artifacts/current/<task_id>/` manual boards only (no hook GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV/digest, 2026-05). `my-light` profile: no REVIEW_GATE hard block.
lifecycle_by_host.codex-cli: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal/RFV via `framework_goal_drive` / `framework_rfv_loop` stdio + manual boards only; no continuity digest or GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV_LOOP_CONTINUE on hooks.
lifecycle_by_host.codex-app: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal/RFV via MCP stdio tools + manual boards; no CLI Stop hook bundle on this transport.
lifecycle_by_host.claude-code: **Default lifecycle: My** — `/discussx` → `/planx` → `/implementx` → `/verifyx`. Goal/RFV via stdio + manual boards; `router-rs claude hook` does not inject GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV/digest (review/closeout advisories only).
lifecycle_by_host.claude-desktop: **默认生命周期：My** — `/discussx` → `/planx` → `/implementx` → `/verifyx`。Goal 经 MCP stdio（`goal_state_manage`）；非 `my-light` 时 `closeout_gate` / complete 在 MCP 工具层硬拦；无 PreToolUse/Stop shell hook。
lifecycle_by_host.antigravity-cli: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal/RFV via stdio + manual boards; CLI hooks under `.antigravitycli/` (`router-rs host antigravity-cli hook …`). REVIEW_GATE uses PostToolUse + Stop (Codex-style), not Cursor multiset.
lifecycle_by_host.antigravity-app: **Default lifecycle: My** (same chain). Goal drive via MCP stdio; hard closeout gate at MCP tool level (`goal_state_manage` / `closeout_gate`). No shell hook bundle on this transport.
lifecycle_by_host.antigravity: **Deprecated alias of antigravity-app.** Same MCP lifecycle as `antigravity-app`; prefer `install --to antigravity-app`.

review_findings_only_paragraph: **Code review default (all hosts): findings-only.** Explicit `$code-review-deep` or review requests still apply at skill layer; under `my-light`, Cursor/Codex hooks do not hard-block Stop on REVIEW_GATE or inject spawn-first nudge. See `skills/code-review-deep/SKILL.md`.
